LanguageData.TL_BookBenefits: Every 60 reading ticks: randomly train a major passion (+20 XP), then a minor passion (+15 XP), then distribute a total of 15–20 XP evenly. Passion skills stop at 18, general skills at 10. Quality multiplies XP by 0.5–2. Daily saturation applies above 4000 XP.
